audit_protocol_delta.reason: S18-S29 follow the corrected paragraph protocol; defended content is not rewritten for cosmetic churn.

carry_forward_constraints: S30 must not consume candidate/entity truth from S29 unless pair uniqueness, membership state/versioning and decision/evidence provenance are validated; duplicate (A,B) rows or mutable decisions are not creditable truth-store evidence.
Keep the inherited Level-2 regression pack active; persisting upstream hardcoded success/approval does not make it trustworthy.
Use real pytest for S30 blocking/comparator/evaluation contracts. Printed SQL/query outputs are diagnostics, not test gates.
A candidate pair must have one canonical identity with CHECK(A<B)+UNIQUE(A,B) or equivalent; S30 must reject duplicate/mirrored pairs rather than double-count them in metrics.
Missing names/identifiers remain non-evidence; do not inherit S28 empty-empty similarity=1.0 into S30 comparator or probability training.
Define one shared Unicode normalization policy before S30 labeled-pair generation so NFC/NFD/casefold behavior matches repository persistence.
Treat SQLite score columns as affinity-typed unless strict validation is added; booleans/text-coerced numbers must not silently become model/matching scores.
S30 review queues must derive current/latest workflow state, not NOT EXISTS(any decision). A historical 'review' event must not make a case disappear from human review.
When selecting top pending cases, filter pending first and then rank with a deterministic tie-breaker; rank-before-antijoin can starve valid cases.
S30 labels/evidence must reference exact immutable decision versions and source artifacts; free-form evidence_ref strings are insufficient ground truth.
Do not train/evaluate on labels whose allowed domain, reviewer identity, timestamps or version are unconstrained. S29 decision labels currently accept arbitrary strings.

If current-state entity attributes are upserted, S30 must bind labeled pairs/features to the exact entity/source version used; stale replay or later overwrite must not change historical training truth retroactively.
IntegrityError is not a generic transient retry signal. Duplicate-candidate uniqueness conflicts may resolve idempotently; FK/CHECK/NOT NULL failures are data/invariant errors until proven otherwise.

SQLite :memory: evidence does not prove persistence, Postgres isolation, locking or recovery. Any S30 claim that depends on restart/concurrency must use an appropriate persistent/real-engine test or bound the claim.
Preserve source→membership→entity history; do not DELETE source/entity link rows to represent changed resolution without a version/event that keeps the previous state reconstructable.
Repository abstractions in S30 must use the same constrained canonical schema; do not introduce a test repository that silently drops FK/CHECK/UNIQUE invariants.
